steps.hints: ❓ What variable should be in the col parameter in the [place sprite on top of] block so that the value updates each time the [for index] loop is run?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which value is updated each time the [for index] loop runs?


Solution: 

A (column) variable should be dragged from the [for index] loop and placed in the col parameter of the [place sprite on top of] block.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, only one bubble appears on the screen. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that 6 bubbles appear on the screen when the project is started.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the [for index] loop correctly places each bubble sprite on the tilemap!

validationItems.text: (column) variable is dragged into col parameter in [place sprite on top of] block.
validationItems.failureText: Check the col parameter in the [place sprite on top of] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓What variable should be used in the outer [for index] loop so that the col and row parameter values update each time the [for index] loop runs?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How can you create a new variable bubble?


Solution: 

The (index) variable should be replaced with a (row) variable in the outer [for index] loop.
steps.instructions:
When you click ▶, the bubbles only appear in one row. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the bubbles are placed across 5 rows on the screen.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the [for index] loop correctly places each bubble sprite on the tilemap!

validationItems.text: (index) is replaced with (row) variable in [for index] loop.
validationItems.failureText: Check the variable used in the [for index] loop.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓Do the parameter values in the [for (column)] and [for (row)] loops place bubble sprites across all rows of the tilemap?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ When a [for index] loop runs, what value does it begin counting at?

❓How can you determine how many times a [for index] loop will run?


Solution: 

The parameter in the [for (row)] loop should be changed to 5; the parameter in the [for (column)] loop should be changed to 9.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, bubbles appear only on the left half of the screen.


Fix the bugs in the code so that bubble sprites are placed across all rows of the tilemap, except the floor.

subgroups.title: Debugging For Index Loops

namespace SpriteKind {
    export const Paddle = SpriteKind.create()
    export const Bubble = SpriteKind.create()
}
sprites.onOverlap(SpriteKind.Player, SpriteKind.Paddle, function (sprite, otherSprite) {
    sprite.setVelocity(randint(-50, 50), randint(-150, -50))
})
function createBubbles () {
    row = 0
    column = 0
    for (let row = 0; row <= 9; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column <= 5; column++) {
            bubbleSprite = sprites.create(img`
                . . . . . b b b b b b . . . . . 
                . . . b b 9 9 9 9 9 9 b b . . .
